rule.build: a player-like build at the person's level (the same pillar scaling as the player, Scaling.pillarCap), focused by niche
rule.niche_edge: they fight niche_edge levels higher in their niche (the roster's value)
rule.clan: clan members add their clan's techniques of every tier their level reaches (10, 20, 32, 44) and the kekkei genkai stage; clanless add the lesser techniques of up to two friendly clans
rule.nature: the roster's nature, else the clan's suggested nature, else rolled from the combat stream (domain combat, key the role)
rule.style: taijutsu niche: Strong Fist (or the clan style); weapons niche: the clan's weapon style, else Crescent Moon from level 15
rule.ai: Fighter skill by rank: genin average, chunin and up skilled; squad role from Progression (vanguard, support, sensor, medic)
rule.never_killed: allies are knocked out at 30% health and can be revived

combat:ally.teammate_b.pet: ninken pup (bites every third landed hit; grows with its owner's level)
